==Description==
'''Job Application''' is an exclusive sticker obtained from the [[Null & Void Event]]. It was obtained from Level 19 of the premium track, which had a cost of {{GumDrops|460}} or {{Robux|46}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|3,178}} or {{Robux|996}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|58}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Robux|1,255}}.

==Appearance==
'''Job Application''' showcases a giant floating job application behind the default [[Scout]], who appears unsettled by its presence.

==Trivia==
*The sticker is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/job-application-form job application jumpscare] meme.
